public_payload.normalized_proposition: Microsoft has an estimated $106.7 billion in short-lived, uninstalled GPUs from FY2025–FY2026 capex.

statement.excerpt: This leaves us with an estimated $106.7 billion in short-lived, uninstalled GPUs.

our_interpretation: The claim concerns the acquisition cost of GPUs remaining uninstalled, rather than total equipment purchases or depreciated carrying value.
Use June 30, 2026, the endpoint of the fiscal years used in the calculation, as the inventory measurement date. This is the latest completed reporting period before publication.
The acquisition cohort is FY2025–FY2026. An estimate needs a defensible reconciliation of GPU purchases and installations; adding spending categories does not establish the remaining inventory.
Treat $106.7 billion as approximate. Do not impose an unstated numerical tolerance.
criteria.support_condition: A credible reconciliation identifies approximately $106.7 billion of Microsoft GPUs purchased during FY2025–FY2026 and still uninstalled at June 30, 2026, after excluding CPUs and other equipment.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable purchasing and installation records establish an uninstalled GPU value materially incompatible with $106.7 billion, allowing for reasonable estimation uncertainty.
